data.body:
[P2] Persist the manifest before starting adapter work

Neither branch fsyncs the manifest contents: an existing manifest is only read, and `_write_new_manifest()` only writes and closes it. Syncing the attempt journal and its directory does not persist another file's contents. A crash after a durably journaled dispatch can therefore leave an empty or stale manifest, losing the profile, resource, and artifact bindings needed for recovery. Flush and fsync the manifest, including a matching caller-supplied file, and sync its parent before loading the adapter. Add a persistence test verifying this ordering.
